summary: The VU Fellowship Programme waives tuition for a small number of excellent non-EU students on full-time English-taught master's at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam starting in September 2027. Applying also puts you in line for one of 20 to 25 NL Scholarships of €5,000. Apply for your master's by 1 December 2026 and for the fellowship by 1 February 2027.
meta_title: VU Amsterdam Fellowship Programme 2027: tuition waiver
meta_description: VU Amsterdam's Fellowship Programme waives master's tuition for top non-EU students, plus €5,000 NL Scholarships. Apply by 1 February 2027.
covers: Tuition fees only, for the first year and, on a two-year programme, the second if you earn all first-year credits.
NL Scholarship: €5,000 towards living costs in the first year, for 20 to 25 students. You are considered automatically with your fellowship application.
eligibility: A non-EU/EEA passport, not eligible for the lower fee, with no earlier Dutch degree or enrolment. The NL Scholarship also excludes students from Suriname and Switzerland.
A bachelor's GPA equivalent to a Dutch 8.
Conditional or unconditional admission to a full-time English-taught master's starting in September 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply for your master's; VU advises doing so by 1 December 2026.
Once conditionally admitted, submit the fellowship application in the VU dashboard between 1 November 2026 and 1 February 2027 at 23:59 CET. You may choose one programme and submit once.
Results come in mid-March 2027 and must be accepted by the end of March.
watch_out: Fellows act as VU ambassadors during their master's.
Living costs beyond the €5,000 NL Scholarship are yours to cover.
costs: You, with €5,000 for NL Scholarship holders
documents: The VU Fellowship application in the VU dashboard

faq.q: What does the VU Fellowship cover?
faq.a: Tuition fees only. Some applicants also receive a €5,000 NL Scholarship towards living costs.

faq.q: When is the VU Fellowship deadline?
faq.a: 1 February 2027 at 23:59 CET. VU advises applying for the master's by 1 December 2026.
A bachelor's GPA equivalent to a Dutch 8.
